training.data_named: trajectories generated from GSM8K, PRM12K, NuminaMath-CoT and AceCode

main_sampler.description: multi-block decoding (similar to d3LLM) with confidence threshold 0.90 to 0.95, greedy, block size 32, no KV cache

study.venue_line_text: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027

credited_component.text: token confidence alone does not capture the downstream utility of a commitment (identified limitation)

design.other_detail: D02: the student is trained on intermediate states of schedule-optimized (surprisal-reduction) unmasking trajectories of correct responses, not on independently masked positions at a shared level. D15: cross-entropy over masked positions plus entropy sharpening on currently correct positions, plus beta-weighted KL to the frozen base model on failed-trajectory states.
design.inherited_from: LLaDA-8B-Instruct (focal; the second own model loads Dream-7B-Instruct); D07 from the cited d3LLM multi-block decoding

census.F2_detail: All models decode greedily (App. C; Eq. 3 greedy token assignment); positions committed by a confidence threshold of 0.90 to 0.95 in multi-block decoding (position rule C with stated argmax token rule, coded A); block size 32; no KV cache; no guidance or selection stated.
